title: A clear answer joins a fuller account
meaning: You can gently request a clear answer and preserve personal explanation, feeling conversation move without reducing it to one word.
text: Strength in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in a direct request that does not sharply cut the listener off. Temperance in energy supports the wish to combine a specific answer with personal explanation. The Chariot in emotions brings direction when the question under discussion is clear. Conversation can move forward without opposing a brief “yes” or “no” to a substantial account of what stands behind that answer.

For example, you ask whether you are ready to show a joint draft to others. A lengthy account of doubts follows, and you can gently ask for the present position first while retaining room for its reasons. **A specific answer helps an explanation be heard rather than replaces it**. You learn that waiting is preferred and discuss why. The exchange gains direction because personal details now relate to an understandable answer. Yet requesting clarity does not require settling every doubt immediately or surrendering the right to revise a position after discussion.

Haste interferes if finding direction becomes a reason to hear no more explanation. A brief answer is then removed from conversation as a final result while its grounds are declared unnecessary. Constructive Temperance helps keep both parts alive. You can hear a clear position and continue discussing its meaning; progress is not measured by how quickly you end every detail important to the other person.
